Released in 2006 , it is the twelfth title in the mainline Final Fantasy series .	Final Fantasy	Final Fantasy

The game introduced several innovations to the series : an open world split into zones , a seamless battle system , a controllable camera , a customizable `` gambit '' system which lets the player control the artificial intelligence -LRB- AI -RRB- of characters in battle ; and a `` license '' system that determines which abilities and equipment are used by characters .	open world	open world	artificial intelligence	Artificial intelligence (video games)
Final Fantasy XII also includes elements from previous games in the series , such as Chocobos and Moogles .	Final Fantasy	Final Fantasy	Moogles	Moogles
The game takes place in the fictional land of Ivalice , where the empires of Archadia and Rozarria are waging an endless war .	fictional land	fictional location	Ivalice	Ivalice
Dalmasca , a small kingdom , is caught between the warring nations .
When Dalmasca is annexed by Archadia , its princess , Ashe , creates a resistance movement .
During the struggle , she meets Vaan , a young adventurer who dreams of becoming a sky pirate in command of an airship .	sky pirate	sky pirate
They are quickly joined by a band of allies ; together , they rally against the tyranny of the Archadian Empire .

Final Fantasy XII received critical acclaim , earning numerous `` Game of the Year '' awards in various categories from noted video game publications .	Final Fantasy	Final Fantasy	Game of the Year	Game of the Year	video game publications	video game journalism
Selling more than two million copies in Japan , it became the fourth best-selling PlayStation 2 game of 2006 worldwide .	PlayStation 2	PlayStation 2
By November 2009 , over 6 million copies of the game were sold worldwide .
A sequel , Final Fantasy XII : Revenant Wings , was released for the Nintendo DS in 2007 .	Final Fantasy	Final Fantasy	Nintendo DS	Nintendo DS
